items.title: THE BACKROOMS
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
You never know what you'll find lurking around every corner. These monsters are so creepy and yet so cool!

- 9 creature skins

items.title: Cat Cottage
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
The cutest cottage is filled with lovable cats that would love to bake bread for you!

- 5 skins

items.title: Wither Plus Add-on
items.creator: A Foxy Toast
items.description:
Wither Plus brings the ultimate Wither expansion to your World!
Face powerful new Withers, collect unique beacons, and encounter mysterious skeletons.
Craft exclusive furniture and decorations, and complete your collection of eerie yet adorable pets!
Includes new Wither bosses, unique skeleton mobs, craftable furniture, decorations, and a set of collectible pets.

items.title: HOUSE MANSION
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description: Welcome to your new house built for a millionaire! This giant mansion is inviting, making it the ideal house to begin your adventure or roleplay!

items.title: SKULL
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
You will become the most feared with the SKULL skin pack! Choose any of these scary skull themed skins to haunt your opponents!

+ Multiple skins to choose from

items.title: SIGMA
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description: Choose any of these SIGMA skins! Roleplay or go on a adventure with these fun and modern looking skins! Show off your aura with these sigma teen outfits!

items.title: Rustic Log Mansion 2
items.creator: CrackedCubes
items.description:
Welcome home! In this sequel, step over the threshold into your new mega log cabin home, nestled within its own private grounds!

+ Large cabin-style mansion with luxury interiors
+ Guest houses, pools, treetop parkour, and gardens to explore
+ Custom modern vehicles, furniture, skins, and textures

From the team at CrackedCubes

items.title: Dinosaurs
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Collect items and craft custom weapons. Use them to fight and tame dinosaurs. After taming a dino, you can craft armor for it and ride it into battle. Each dinosaur has its own abilities and strengths to help you win fights!

+Custom craftable weapons!
+Dino control mode with abilities!
+Custom generated buildings and volcanoes!

items.title: PAINTERS
items.creator: Novasoft
items.description: The perfect skin pack for artists and builders! Express your creative side with these 5 art themed skins!

items.title: Kawaii Pets x Teens
items.creator: Some Game Studio
items.description:
Love carrying CUTE PETS? Then this is the pack for YOU! Perfect your Gameplay experience with these 80 skins, full of cool outfits and selection of pets.

+ Includes 80 skins
+ Featuring chill teens and cute pet themed skins.

items.title: Superman Skin Pack
items.creator: Oreville Studios
items.description: Skin up like a true Super Hero with the free Superman Skin Pack! Pick your favorite from five skins, including Superman, Lois Lane, Green Lantern, Hawkgirl, and even Mr. Terrific... suit up in a new skin today!

items.title: ASSASSIN
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description: FEAR THE ASSASSIN! Lurk in the dark and be ready to strike! Choose any of these epic assassin skins and take out your next target!

items.title: Simple Texture Pack
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description: Upgrade the textures in any of your worlds with the Simple Texture Pack! Make your world even more colorful and charming with these simplistic textures!

items.title: REDSTONE CASTLE
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description: Enjoy your very own redstone castle! This world spawn is ready for you to move into. The castle is built using tons of redstone blocks and ore!

items.title: SUIT
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description: Dress up and be fancy in a suit! Wear a tuxedo, a colorful suit, or even a secret agent outfit. Perfect for looking awesome, roleplay, or going on fun adventures in style!

items.title: SCARY Add-On
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
+ Scary Add-On
+ Tons of monsters
+ Custom animations
+ One of the best Add-Ons for jump-scares

Looking for something scary? These scary monsters will haunt YOUR WORLD and stack it with other Add-Ons!

items.title: Bear Buddies
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Meet the Bear Buddies! 
These 8 adorable friends are here to brighten your adventures! Dressed in stylish, cute outfits, they come in different fashions and colors! Whether you're building, battling, or just hanging out, these cuddly squad members are ready to be your beary best companions.

- 8 unique Bear Skins
- For roleplay, adventures & more!

items.title: Medieval Fantasy
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Medieval and fantasy? Incredible! Let's try it with these amazing skins and outfits that you will love!

-12 skins!
- 2 free skins!

items.title: Red VS Blue
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Red? Or Blue? Which color will you choose? Decide with these incredible costumes and defend your favorite color!

-12 skins!
- 2 free skins!

items.title: Red VS Blue Neon
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Cute and shiny! But choosing a side? Which one would you choose!

-12 skins!
- 2 free skins!

items.title: SHADOW MONSTERS
items.creator: Lothiredon
items.description:
The shadows aren’t safe with these SHADOW MONSTER skins! 

+ 10 HD Shadow monsters!
+ Ideal for roleplay!

items.title: CREAKY CREATURES
items.creator: Lothiredon
items.description:
Step into The Pale Gardens at your peril! Lurk in the dark and scare your friends with this CREAKING CREATURE skin pack.

+ 10 Creaking monster skins!
+ Ideal for roleplay!

items.title: Neon Glow Gamers
items.creator: Tristan Productions
items.description: These gamers are wearing dark neon outfits. With an assortment of glowing colourful accessories such as crowns, bandanas, sunglasses, demon horns and more, you will be the coolest player in the game!

items.title: Golden Flowers
items.creator: Tristan Productions
items.description: These rich friends love their floral outfits! The luxury golden flower designs are perfect for any elevated spring or summer gathering!
